issue.title: [202405][DNX] orchagent exited because of failing to set SAI_NEIGHBOR_ENTRY_ATTR_IS_LOCAL

failure.body:
#### Description

We noticed following orchagent failure in T2 testing with 202405 image.

```
2024 Jul 13 <IPV6>.646591 xxx405-3 INFO swss#supervisord: orchagent
2024 Jul 13 <IPV6>.815226 xxx405-3 ERR syncd#syncd: [none] SAI_API_NEIGHBOR:brcm_sai_set_neighbor_entry_attribute:597 Error processing nbr entry attribute failed with error Unknown error (0xfffd0000).
2024 Jul 13 <IPV6>.815226 xxx405-3 ERR syncd#syncd: :- sendApiResponse: api SAI_COMMON_API_SET failed in syncd mode: SAI_STATUS_FAILURE
2024 Jul 13 <IPV6>.815383 xxx405-3 ERR syncd#syncd: :- processQuadEvent: attr: SAI_NEIGHBOR_ENTRY_ATTR_IS_LOCAL: false
2024 Jul 13 <IPV6>.815875 xxx405-3 INFO swss#supervisord: orchagent
2024 Jul 13 <IPV6>.815875 xxx405-3 ERR swss#orchagent: :- set: set status: SAI_STATUS_FAILURE
2024 Jul 13 <IPV6>.815875 xxx405-3 ERR swss#orchagent: :- addNeighbor: Failed to update neighbor <IPV6> on nfc405-7|Asic0|Ethernet180, attr.id=0x8, rv:-1
2024 Jul 13 <IPV6>.815875 xxx405-3 ERR swss#orchagent: :- handleSaiSetStatus: Encountered failure in set operation, exiting orchagent, SAI API: SAI_API_NEIGHBOR, status: SAI_STATUS_FAILURE
```

The failure was observed with `arp/test_neighbor_mac_noptf.py` and `arp/test_arpall.py`.
